spots.name: The Venetian
spots.summary: The Venetian Las Vegas is a luxury hotel and casino resort located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. It is owned by Vici Properties and operated by Apollo Global Management. It was developed by businessman Sheldon Adelson through his company, Las Vegas Sands.

spots.name: Las Vegas Strip
spots.summary: The Las Vegas Strip is a stretch of Las Vegas Boulevard in Clark County, Nevada, that is known for its concentration of resort hotels and casinos.

spots.name: Bellagio

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Bellagio is a resort, luxury hotel, and casino on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It is owned by Blackstone Inc. and operated by MGM Resorts International. Bellagio was conceived by casino owner Steve Wynn, and was built on the former site of the Dunes hotel-casino.

spots.name: MGM Grand Las Vegas
spots.summary: The MGM Grand Las Vegas, often called The Grand Hotel or The MGM is a hotel and casino located on the Las Vegas Strip in Nevada. It is owned by Vici Properties and operated by MGM Resorts International. The resort was developed by Kirk Kerkorian through his company, MGM Grand, Inc.

spots.name: The Strat
spots.summary: The Strat is a hotel and casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States. It includes a 1,149-foot-tall (350 m) observation tower, the tallest in the United States. It is also the second-tallest observation tower in the Western Hemisphere, surpassed only by the CN Tower in Toronto, Ontario.

spots.name: Flamingo Las Vegas
spots.summary: Flamingo Las Vegas is a casino hotel on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It is owned and operated by Caesars Entertainment. The Flamingo includes a 72,299 sq ft (6,716.8 m2) casino and a 28-story hotel with 3,460 rooms.

spots.name: New York-New York Hotel and Casino
spots.summary: New York-New York Hotel and Casino is a casino hotel on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. It is owned by Vici Properties and operated by MGM Resorts International, and is designed to evoke New York City in its architecture and other aspects.
spots.wikipediaTitle: New York-New York Hotel and Casino

spots.name: Westgate Las Vegas

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino is a hotel, casino, and timeshare resort in Winchester, Nevada. Located near the northern end of the Las Vegas Strip, it is owned by Westgate Resorts.

spots.name: Hard Rock Hotel and Casino

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Hard Rock Hotel & Casino was a resort located near the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. Virgin Hotels Las Vegas opened at the site following renovations, in 2021.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Hard Rock Hotel and Casino (Las Vegas)

spots.name: Fontainebleau Las Vegas

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is a luxury resort and casino on the Las Vegas Strip in Winchester, Nevada.

spots.name: Wynn Las Vegas

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Wynn Las Vegas, often simply referred to as Wynn, is a luxury resort and casino located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. It is owned and operated by Wynn Resorts, and was built on the former site of the Desert Inn resort, which opened in 1950.

spots.name: Tropicana Las Vegas

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tropicana Las Vegas was a casino hotel on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It operated from 1957 to 2024. In its final years, the property included a 44,570 sq ft (4,141 m2) casino and 1,467 rooms.

spots.name: Treasure Island Hotel and Casino

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Treasure Island Hotel and Casino is a pirate-themed hotel and casino located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, U.S. It includes 2,885 rooms and a 47,927 sq ft (4,452.6 m2) casino. The resort is owned and operated by businessman Phil Ruffin.

spots.name: Golden Nugget Las Vegas
spots.summary: The Golden Nugget Las Vegas is a luxury hotel and casino located in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada, United States, on the Fremont Street Experience. The property is owned and operated by Landry's, Inc. It has 2,419 hotel rooms.

spots.name: The Palazzo

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Palazzo is a luxury hotel and casino resort located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. The Palazzo is part of a larger complex comprising the adjoining Venetian resort and Venetian Expo, all of which are owned by Vici Properties and operated by Apollo Global Management.

spots.name: High Roller
spots.summary: High Roller is a 550-foot-tall (167.6 m), 520-foot (158.5 m) diameter giant Ferris wheel on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. Owned and operated by Caesars Entertainment, it opened to the public on March 31, 2014 as the world's tallest Ferris wheel.

spots.name: Aria Resort and Casino

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Aria Resort and Casino is a luxury resort and casino, and the primary property at the CityCenter complex, located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It is owned by The Blackstone Group and operated by MGM Resorts International.

spots.name: Fountains of Bellagio
spots.summary: Fountains of Bellagio is a free attraction at the Bellagio resort, located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It consists of a musical fountain show performed in an 8.5-acre (3.4 ha) man-made lake in front of the resort. The show uses 1,214 water nozzles and 4,792 lights.

spots.name: Mob Museum
spots.summary: The Mob Museum, officially the National Museum of Organized Crime and Law Enforcement, is a history museum located in Downtown Las Vegas, Nevada, United States.

spots.name: Park MGM

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Park MGM, formerly Monte Carlo Resort and Casino, is a megaresort hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. It is owned by Vici Properties and operated by MGM Resorts International. It was developed by Mirage Resorts and Circus Circus Enterprises, both later acquired by MGM.

spots.name: Fremont Street Experience
spots.summary: The Fremont Street Experience (FSE) is a pedestrian mall and attraction in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada. The FSE occupies the westernmost five blocks of Fremont Street, including the area known for years as "Glitter Gulch", and portions of some other adjacent streets.

spots.name: Hard Rock Las Vegas
spots.summary: Hard Rock Las Vegas is a casino hotel resort under construction at the center of the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It is owned by Vici Properties and leased by Hard Rock International. A previous casino resort, The Mirage, opened on the site in 1989 and will be incorporated into the new project.

spots.name: Palms Casino Resort

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Palms Casino Resort is a hotel and casino located near the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. It is owned and operated by the Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation. It includes 703 rooms and a 94,065 sq ft (8,738.9 m2) casino.

spots.name: Riviera

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Riviera was a hotel and casino on the northern Las Vegas Strip in Winchester, Nevada. It opened on April 20, 1955, and included a nine-story hotel featuring 291 rooms. The Riviera was the first skyscraper in the Las Vegas Valley, and was the area's tallest building until 1956.

spots.name: The Colosseum at Caesars Palace
spots.summary: The Colosseum at Caesars Palace is a theater located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. It is the main entertainment venue for Caesars Palace.

spots.name: Guggenheim Hermitage Museum

hours.note: Closed Fri, Sat

spots.summary: The Guggenheim Hermitage Museum was a museum owned and originally operated by the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation. It was located in The Venetian resort on the Las Vegas Strip, and operated from October 7, 2001, to May 11, 2008.

spots.name: The Harmon

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Harmon was an unfinished high-rise building at the CityCenter development, located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It was named after its location at the intersection of Harmon Avenue and Las Vegas Boulevard.

spots.name: Vegas Vic
spots.summary: Vegas Vic is a neon sign portraying a cowboy which was erected on the exterior of The Pioneer Club in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States in 1951. The sign was a departure in graphic design from typeface based neon signs, to the friendly and welcoming human form of a cowboy.

spots.name: Encore

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Encore Las Vegas is a luxury resort, casino and hotel located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. The resort is connected to its sister resort, Wynn Las Vegas, located directly south.

spots.name: El Cortez

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: El Cortez, a hotel and casino, is a relatively small downtown Las Vegas gaming venue a block from the Fremont Street Experience and Las Vegas Boulevard. Slots, table games, and a race and sports book occupy one floor of the main pavilion, at this historic casino.

spots.name: Big Apple Coaster
spots.summary: The Big Apple Coaster is a steel roller coaster at the New York-New York Hotel and Casino on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. The ride's trains are themed to New York City taxicabs.

spots.name: Vdara

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Vdara is a condo-hotel within the CityCenter complex, located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada. It was designed by Rafael Viñoly, and is located across from CityCenter's Aria Resort & Casino. Vdara opened on December 2, 2009 as a joint venture between MGM Resorts International and Dubai World.

spots.name: Adventuredome
spots.summary: Adventuredome is a 5-acre (2 ha) indoor amusement park at Circus Circus in Winchester, Nevada on the Las Vegas Strip. It is owned by Phil Ruffin.

spots.name: PH Live
spots.summary: PH Live is a mid-sized auditorium in the Planet Hollywood Las Vegas hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. The venue hosts events including charity benefits, concerts and award shows including beauty pageants such as Miss Universe, Miss USA and Miss Teen USA.

spots.name: Vegas World

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Vegas World was a space-themed casino and hotel on Las Vegas Boulevard in Las Vegas, Nevada. It was owned and operated by Bob Stupak, and was also signed as Bob Stupak's Vegas World.

spots.name: Burlesque Hall of Fame

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Burlesque Hall of Fame (BHOF) was the world's only museum dedicated to the history, preservation, and future of the art of burlesque. Located in the Las Vegas Arts district at 1027 S Main St.

spots.name: Boardwalk Hotel and Casino

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Boardwalk Hotel and Casino was a Coney Island-style hotel on the Las Vegas Strip. The property began in 1966, as a Holiday Inn. Norbert Jansen added a gift shop to the hotel in 1972, and later opened the Slot Joynt casino. In 1985, Jansen renamed the Holiday Inn as the Viscount Hotel, part of a U.S. chain.

spots.name: Old Las Vegas Mormon Fort

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sun

spots.summary: Old Las Vegas Mormon Fort State Historic Park is a state park of Nevada. It contains the Old Mormon Fort, the first permanent structure built in what would become Las Vegas fifty years later.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Old Las Vegas Mormon Fort State Historic Park

spots.name: X-Scream
spots.summary: X-Scream is a ride at the top of the Strat SkyPod in Las Vegas, Nevada. At a height of approximately 866 feet (264 m), the world's third highest amusement ride, located on top of The Strat. The name of the ride is a play on the word extreme.

spots.name: Big Shot
spots.summary: Big Shot is a pneumatically powered tower ride. It was the world's highest amusement ride in terms of overall elevation above ground level, but has since been surpassed by the Sky Drop ride atop the Canton Tower in Guangzhou.

spots.name: Tropicana – Las Vegas Boulevard intersection
spots.summary: The Tropicana – Las Vegas Boulevard intersection is a major intersection on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States, and is noteworthy for several reasons.

spots.name: Guardian Angel Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Guardian Angel Cathedral is a Catholic cathedral in Winchester, Nevada, United States, in the Las Vegas Valley. It is located just off of the Las Vegas Strip, north of the Wynn and Encore hotels. It is the seat of the Archdiocese of Las Vegas.

spots.name: National Atomic Testing Museum
spots.summary: The National Atomic Testing Museum in Las Vegas, Nevada, documents the history of nuclear testing at the Nevada Test Site (NTS) in the Mojave Desert about 65 miles northwest of Las Vegas. The museum operates as an affiliate of the Smithsonian Institution.

spots.name: Main Street Station

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Main Street Station is a hotel and casino in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada. It is owned by Boyd Gaming. It originally opened in 1978 as the Holiday International, part of the Holiday Inn franchise. The casino portion closed in 1980, due to financial problems, and the hotel closed four years later.

spots.name: Battlefield Vegas

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Battlefield Vegas is an American shooting range and outdoor military museum located off the Las Vegas Strip in Winchester, Nevada. Founded by David Famiglietti, Ron Cheney, and Karla Cheney, the five-acre complex opened on October 1, 2012.

spots.name: SkyJump Las Vegas
spots.summary: SkyJump Las Vegas is a commercial decelerator located at The Strat on the Las Vegas Strip. It holds the Guinness World Record for highest commercial decelerator descent with an official height of 829 ft (253 m).

spots.name: Springs Preserve
spots.summary: Las Vegas Springs Preserve consists of 180 acres (73 ha) dedicated to nature walks and displays and is owned and operated by the Las Vegas Valley Water District. The Preserve is located approximately three miles west of downtown Las Vegas, Nevada.

spots.name: Canyon Blaster
spots.summary: Canyon Blaster is an indoor roller coaster at the Adventuredome theme park in Winchester, Nevada. It features back-to-back vertical loops and corkscrews, and ends with a helix inside the mountain that takes up a large portion of the park.

spots.name: Speed – The Ride
spots.summary: Speed – The Ride was a roller coaster in storage at Akita Plaza on the Las Vegas Strip in Nevada. Originally located at the Sahara Hotel and Casino, it opened to the public on April 28, 2000, and closed on May 1, 2011.

spots.name: Wee Kirk o' the Heather

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Wee Kirk o' the Heather was a wedding chapel in Las Vegas, Nevada. The chapel opened in the early 1940s when Mrs. J Edwards Webb began performing wedding ceremonies in the front room of a home that was built in the 1920s. The business was known as Webb’s Wedding Chapel, then as Wee Kirk o’ the Heather.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Wee Kirk o' the Heather (Las Vegas)

spots.name: Allure Las Vegas

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Allure Las Vegas is a condominium tower in Las Vegas, Nevada. The 41-story, 466 ft (142 m) tower was built between 2005 and 2007 and was designed by EDI Architecture. Construction was managed by Bovis Lend Lease.

spots.name: Las Vegas Grammar School
spots.summary: The Las Vegas Grammar School is a school listed on the National Register of Historic Places in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States. The school sits on a 20-acre (8.1 ha) site off of Las Vegas Boulevard at 401 South Fourth Street in Downtown Las Vegas.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Las Vegas Grammar School (Las Vegas Boulevard, Las Vegas, Nevada)

spots.name: Las Vegas Little Theater
spots.summary: Las Vegas Little Theater is a community theater in Las Vegas, Nevada that was founded in 1978 by Jack Bell and Jack Nickolson. Acting classes are available. It is the oldest operating small theater in the valley.

spots.name: Railroad Cottage Historic District
spots.summary: The Railroad Cottage Historic District is an area originally comprising eight historic cottages along Casino Center Boulevard in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada.

spots.name: Las Vegas High School Historic District
spots.summary: The Las Vegas High School Historic District in Las Vegas, Nevada is a historic district which includes 11 buildings on the 15 acres (6.1 ha) campus of the school district. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2022.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Las Vegas High School Historic District

spots.name: Bellagio Conservatory and Botanical Gardens
spots.summary: Inside of the casino is a display of trees and flower arrangements, changed once for every season and once for the Chinese New Year.

spots.name: Eiffel Tower Experience

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: You can take an elevator to the top of the Eiffel Tower on the Strip, a half-sized replica of the one in Paris. This is a popular attraction, especially at night, for its excellent views of the Strip.

spots.name: Madame Tussauds

hours.note: Closed Sat

spots.summary: The only celebrity wax attraction on the Strip, featuring wax recreations of 100+ celebrities and famous figures.

spots.name: Bellagio Gallery of Fine Art
spots.summary: A fine-art gallery. See website for current exhibition.
